items.title: William Russell Interview, 1976-02-16
items.q: competitor of, say, Artie Shaw or Glenn Miller.

ctx.x: I was talking to people the other night, somebody over at Preservation Hall played a tune twice. I was surprised. I don't know if that was Alvin Alcorn, who it was Willie Humphrey, who's a band, I guess it was, did it. And I was just thinking, that Bunk band in New York, they'd hardly ever played a piece once, and usually more than twice, quite often three or four times, people would like, they'd keep clapping, and that's when the Saints became popular, even more than Louie's record, which had been on jukeboxes…
Did you ever hear King Port of Stomp by Goodman?
